### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>klauspost/compress (github.com/klauspost/compress)</summary>

### [`v1.20.4`](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/releases/tag/v1.20.4)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.3...v1.20.4)

#### What's Changed

- zstd: don't reuse a literal table that was not written by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1299](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1299)
- zstd: preserve stream state when resetting options by [@​Grivn](https://redirect.github.com/Grivn) in [#​1266](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1266)
- zstd, huff0, s2: bump the avo arm64 lowering; keep zstd stack slots in registers by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1248](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1248)
- zstd, huff0: faster pure-Go decoders by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1256](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1256)
- zstd: Don't retain pointers to decoded inputs in DecodeAll by [@​Jille](https://redirect.github.com/Jille) in [#​1273](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1273)
- zstd: inline the best encoder's reject path; cap concurrent-blocks job size by [@​bd-dstodolsky](https://redirect.github.com/bd-dstodolsky) in [#​1293](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1293)
- zstd: copy non-overlapping matches in 32-byte blocks by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1295](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1295)
- zstd: cap DecodeAll preallocation to what the input can decode to by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1291](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1291)
- flate: build unrestricted Huffman trees before limiting lengths by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1219](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1219)
- flate: Fix stateless EOF on large writes. by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1265](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1265)
- flate: keep match history across small flushes by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1282](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1282)
- gzip: write and read a zero MTIME for a zero ModTime by [@​spicysharkco](https://redirect.github.com/spicysharkco) in [#​1268](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1268)
- zip: accept 0xFFFFFFFF sizes and offsets without a Zip64 extra by [@​ybai08](https://redirect.github.com/ybai08) in [#​1267](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1267)
- zip: backport the standard library's writer-side Zip64 fixes by [@​ybai08](https://redirect.github.com/ybai08) in [#​1287](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1287)
- gzip: backport two standard library fixes (truncated header EOF, Write count) by [@​ybai08](https://redirect.github.com/ybai08) in [#​1270](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1270)
- gzhttp: let "\*" in Accept-Encoding select gzip or zstd by [@​Shaisolaris](https://redirect.github.com/Shaisolaris) in [#​1263](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1263)
- gzhttp: flush and hijack through http.ResponseController by [@​Neffi42](https://redirect.github.com/Neffi42) in [#​1272](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1272)
- gzhttp: keep Vary: Accept-Encoding when the handler sets Vary by [@​wleeaf](https://redirect.github.com/wleeaf) in [#​1284](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1284)
- gzhttp: don't pool a decoder while a Read is still using it by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1288](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1288)
- gzhttp: clear Content-Length when decoding a compressed request by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1301](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1301)
- huff0: promote the 4X loop's input pointers to registers on arm64 by [@​lizthegrey](https://redirect.github.com/lizthegrey) in [#​1277](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1277)
- s2: verify the CRC of chunk data kept after Skip by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1286](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1286)
- s2: don't read past src when converting LZ4 blocks by [@​Raghuvardhan-Reddy78](https://redirect.github.com/Raghuvardhan-Reddy78) in [#​1294](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1294)
- s2: fix LZ4 converter length overflow (32-bit only) by [@​klauspost](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost) in [#​1300](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1300)
- s2: return ErrDstTooSmall for an LZ4 conversion into a nil dst by [@​yxshee](https://redirect.github.com/yxshee) in [#​1307](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1307)
- s2: keep ErrCorrupt when Skip rejects an oversized chunk by [@​CJstate](https://redirect.github.com/CJstate) in [#​1303](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1303)

#### New Contributors

- [@​Shaisolaris](https://redirect.github.com/Shaisolaris) made their first contribution in [#​1263](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1263)
- [@​Grivn](https://redirect.github.com/Grivn) made their first contribution in [#​1266](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1266)
- [@​spicysharkco](https://redirect.github.com/spicysharkco) made their first contribution in [#​1268](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1268)
- [@​ybai08](https://redirect.github.com/ybai08) made their first contribution in [#​1267](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1267)
- [@​Neffi42](https://redirect.github.com/Neffi42) made their first contribution in [#​1272](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1272)
- [@​wleeaf](https://redirect.github.com/wleeaf) made their first contribution in [#​1284](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1284)
- [@​oddharsh](https://redirect.github.com/oddharsh) made their first contribution in [#​1290](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1290)
- [@​bd-dstodolsky](https://redirect.github.com/bd-dstodolsky) made their first contribution in [#​1293](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1293)
- [@​yxshee](https://redirect.github.com/yxshee) made their first contribution in [#​1307](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1307)
- [@​CJstate](https://redirect.github.com/CJstate) made their first contribution in [#​1303](https://redirect.github.com/klauspost/compress/pull/1303)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/klauspost/compress/compare/v1.20.3...v1.20.4>

</details>
